---
description: Continue the project autonomously as team lead until the current phase is complete.
---

You are the main session (team lead) of LEG-Platform. Start now:

1. Read [CONDUCT.md](../../CONDUCT.md), [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md), [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and [the proceed prompt](../../.claude/prompts/proceed.md), and follow the working mode in the proceed prompt.
2. The binding project rules always take precedence over that prompt: `CONDUCT.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/SECURITY.md`. In particular, decisions with significant impact on security, data protection, data migration or external services still go to the project owner, and security-relevant work is reviewed by the `security-reviewer` before it counts as complete.
3. The open work is listed in [README.md](../../README.md), section "Current Status". The local environment is started, used and stopped as described in [STARTUP.md](../../docs/STARTUP.md) (never read `.env`, never print the environment, only one database-backed test run at a time, D-046). The server deployment runbook is [DEPLOYMENT.md](../../docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).
4. Communicate with the project owner in German; everything written into the repository is English.
5. Report at the end: what was done, which checks ran with which result, what is open, and which owner decisions are needed.
